stories.title: El papa León advierte en Francia que la ONU corre el riesgo de volverse una "farsa"

en.title: Pope Leo warns in France that the UN risks becoming a "farce"
en.summary: Pope Leo stated that the United Nations and other multilateral organizations are in crisis, warning during a speech at UNESCO's Paris headquarters that international dialogue risks becoming a farce.

stories.title: Huracán Odalys se fortalece a categoría 4; Polo mantiene lluvias en estados de México

en.title: Hurricane Odalys strengthens to category 4; Polo maintains rainfall in Mexican states
en.summary: Hurricane Odalys reached category 4 strength in the Pacific Ocean while Tropical Storm Polo continues bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds to western Mexican states.

stories.title: Megadecomiso tuvo anomalías, afirma García Harfuch

en.title: Large fuel seizure had irregularities, García Harfuch states
en.summary: Mexico's Security Secretary García Harfuch reported that a major fuel theft seizure in Guanajuato contained irregularities and was conducted without proper verifications.

stories.title: Harfuch confirma destitución del delegado de la FGR en Guanajuato; señala anomalías en megadecomiso de combustible

en.title: Harfuch confirms removal of FGR delegate in Guanajuato; points to irregularities in fuel seizure
en.summary: Security Secretary Harfuch confirmed the removal of the federal prosecutor's delegate in Guanajuato and indicated irregularities occurred in a major fuel seizure operation.

stories.title: Consejo de Seguridad de ONU condena ataques de hutíes contra Arabia Saudita; afectan la infraestructura civil y energética

en.title: UN Security Council condemns Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia; affecting civil and energy infrastructure
en.summary: The UN Security Council has condemned attacks by Houthis targeting Saudi Arabia, which have damaged civilian and energy infrastructure facilities.

stories.title: Moody’s prevé apoyo anual mínimo de 10 mil mdd a Pemex por 3 años, mínimo; deuda ajustada de la petrolera ascendía a 97 mil mdd en junio

en.title: Moody's expects minimum annual support of 10 billion USD for Pemex over 3 years; adjusted debt of the oil company reached 97 billion USD in June
en.summary: Moody's projects that Pemex will require at least 10 billion USD in annual support for three years, as the petroleum company's adjusted debt stood at 97 billion USD in June.

stories.title: León XIV advierte en Francia contra las "derivas" de la IA y la ciencia; condena la gestación subrogada y la eutanasia

en.title: Leo XIV warns in France against the "drifts" of AI and science; condemns surrogacy and euthanasia
en.summary: Leo XIV has issued warnings in France regarding potential negative developments in artificial intelligence and science, and expressed opposition to surrogacy and euthanasia.

stories.title: Huracán Polo se intensifica nuevamente a categoría 5; sigue en vivo su desplazamiento

en.title: Hurricane Polo intensifies again to category 5; tracking its movement live
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has strengthened to category 5 status, with ongoing monitoring of its trajectory.

stories.title: Se intensifica 'Polo', de nuevo, a categoría 5

en.title: Hurricane Polo intensifies to category 5 again
en.summary: Hurricane Polo strengthened to category 5 status while located 430 kilometers south-southwest of Cabo Corrientes, Jalisco.

stories.title: Las grandes ligas europeas reclaman reformar la gobernanza de la FIFA

en.title: Major European leagues call for FIFA governance reform
en.summary: The Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, and Bundesliga requested reforms to FIFA's governance structure on Friday.

stories.title: Petróleo cae más de 1% por posibilidad de tregua EU-Irán, pese a ataques hutíes vs Arabia Saudita

en.title: Oil falls over 1% on possibility of US-Iran truce despite Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Oil prices declined more than 1% as markets assessed potential negotiations between the United States and Iran, despite ongoing Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Agrava Pemex carga de deuda.- Moody's

en.title: Pemex worsens debt burden: Moody's
en.summary: Moody's reported that government support for Pemex increases debt obligations, requiring fiscal adjustments exceeding 1.5% of GDP this year to stabilize the situation.

stories.title: México reabre segundo cruce para exportar ganado a EU; CNA exige más recursos sanitarios

en.title: Mexico reopens second crossing to export cattle to US; CNA demands more sanitary resources
en.summary: Mexico reopened a second border crossing for cattle exports to the United States, initially allowing 800 head daily with increases to 1,500 by week four. The sanitary authority requested budget increases and additional resources to support the operation.

stories.title: ¿Cuánto cuesta acceder a preventas? Tarjetas de crédito se convierten en requisito para comprar boletos de conciertos

en.title: How much does pre-sale access cost? Credit cards become a requirement to buy concert tickets
en.summary: Concert pre-sales increasingly require specific credit cards as a practical requirement for accessing tickets, turning card ownership into a barrier for attendance.

stories.title: ¿Tu teléfono te escucha? Esta función de Google puede guardar tus grabaciones de voz

en.title: Is your phone listening to you? This Google feature can save your voice recordings
en.summary: A little-known Google Account setting allows storage of audio recordings from voice searches and interactions, and users can check whether this feature is enabled.

stories.title: Por inflación, gasolinas, refrescos y cigarros incrementarán IEPS en 2027

en.title: Due to inflation, gasoline, soft drinks and cigarettes will increase excise taxes in 2027
en.summary: Mexico will adjust special taxes on gasoline, diesel, soft drinks and cigarettes in 2027 based on inflation recorded in December 2026, estimated at 3.8% annually.

stories.title: La adopción del streaming crece en zonas rurales mientras que en zonas urbanas empieza a moderarse

en.title: Streaming adoption grows in rural areas while moderating in urban zones
en.summary: The shift of sports and entertainment content from traditional television to digital platforms is driving streaming adoption in rural areas, while growth slows in urban regions.
